background_notes.fact: For every natural n, the real coordinate space Ambient n with its given Euclidean inner product and norm is a finite-dimensional real normed vector space. Its coordinate vectors e_j, j∈Fin n, form a basis, including the empty basis for n=0; its metric also supplies an extended metric.

background_notes.justification: Define e_j to have coordinate 1 at j and 0 elsewhere. Each x equals the finite sum Σ_j x_j e_j by evaluation at each coordinate. If Σ_j a_j e_j=0, evaluation at j gives a_j=0, proving independence. For n=0 every vector is the unique empty tuple, and spanning and independence hold for the empty family. Hence the space is finite dimensional. The supplied Euclidean inner product induces the displayed norm and the compatible real normed-space structure. Regard each finite real distance as an extended nonnegative distance to obtain the extended metric, preserving the metric axioms.
